notes.title: June 2024 update now available
notes.content:
The June 2024 update of Pedra Crystal Caves has now been released.

This update includes:


 Once you gain a Pedra upgrade, you keep the upgrade - forever
 The Crystals you collect throughout the game remain with you after you finish a game
 Same starting point for each cave after losing a life
 Additional music options
 Upgraded graphics


Grab your copy today!
